proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4749 *cāmala/*cāvala gives Nepali cāmal and Hindi/Bhojpuri cāwar/cāur husked rice. Sunha/Dang cawr/caur forms match the r series, while Dotyali chāmāl matches the nasal/lateral series with initial aspiration retained. Turner leaves the deeper non-Aryan derivation uncertain. Exact survey form tʃʌɔɾ is preserved.
